# Curling IO Documentation

> Comprehensive documentation for Curling IO - curling registration and league management platform

- [Curling IO Documentation](https://curling.io/index.md)

## curling-club-management-software

All-in-one curling club management software. Online registration and payments, league management, club website, accounting, rental bookings, and waivers. Trusted by Curling Canada, every provincial association, and hundreds of clubs.

- [Curling Club Management Software](https://curling.io/curling-club-management-software.md): All-in-one curling club management software. Online registration and payments, league management, club website, accounting, rental bookings, and waivers. Trusted by Curling Canada, every provincial association, and hundreds of clubs.

## docs


### accounting

- [Accounting Codes](https://curling.io/docs/accounting/accounting-codes.md): Overview
- [Accounting Transactions](https://curling.io/docs/accounting/accounting-transactions.md): Overview
- [Reports](https://curling.io/docs/accounting/reports.md): Curling IO produces reports that give you, the curling club manager or bookkeeper, insight into the financials and membership at your club.

### advanced

- [API](https://curling.io/docs/advanced/api.md): Leagues and Competitions (Events)
- [Augmenting Curler Profiles](https://curling.io/docs/advanced/augmenting-curler-profiles.md): Sometimes you may want to ask your curler's for some additional information, but only once per season (or lifetime).
- [CurlingSchedules.com](https://curling.io/docs/advanced/curlingschedules.md): Learn how to configure draws, track fairness, and manage saved schedules with the Curling Draw Schedule Builder.
- [Multi-Session League Registration](https://curling.io/docs/advanced/multi-session-league-registration.md): Some leagues have several ways to participate. Common examples include fall or winter sessions, Tuesday or Thursday draws, or a full-season option.

### api

- [Event Details](https://curling.io/docs/api/event-details.md): Events are leagues and competitions.
- [Items](https://curling.io/docs/api/items.md): Leagues, competitions, and products can be accessed through the items API via different end points.
- [Product Details](https://curling.io/docs/api/product-details.md): Fetching the product

### club-management

- [Alerts](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/alerts.md): This is a Premium Only Feature
- [Calendar](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/calendar.md): Venue / Ice Booking is Premium Only
- [Club Credits](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/club-credits.md): Club credits allow your users to pay for your leagues, competitions, products, and fees using credit they've accrued.
- [Profiles](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/curlers.md): In Curling IO, profiles belong to your members themselves.
- [Custom Fields](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/custom-fields.md): Custom fields allow you, the curling club manager, to ask any question you like during registration or purchase of one of your leagues, competitions, or products.
- [The Dashboard](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/dashboard.md): When a curling club manager first logs in to the administrator area of Curling IO they will be presented with the dashboard.
- [Discounts](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/discounts.md): You can create discounts to reduce the cost of your leagues, competitions, and products when curler's match criteria that you specify.
- [Emails](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/emails.md): The Emails feature allows you to manage both broadcast emails and transactional email templates for your club. You can send announcements to your members and customize the automated emails that are sent when members make purchases, payments, and receive refunds.
- [Fees](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/fees.md): You can set up membership and capital improvement fees for your club.
- [Integrations](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/integrations.md): This is a Premium Only Feature
- [Leagues & Competitions](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/leagues.md): Walkthrough Video
- [Linking your Website to Curling IO Registration](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/linking-to-registration.md): If you are not using Curling IO to host your website, you'll still want to link to your Curling IO site for registrations.
- [Managers](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/managers.md): Clubs can have multiple managers for Curling IO.
- [Orders](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/orders.md): Walkthrough Video
- [Products and Addons](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/products.md): Walkthrough Video
- [Profile Fields](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/profile-fields.md): You can customize which fields are required, optional, or not asked for profiles at your club.
- [Programs](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/programs.md): Programs sit between products and events: they’re purchased like products, but run on specific dates like leagues and competitions.
- [Item Recommendations](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/recommendations.md): Overview
- [Registration and Results Widget](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/registration-widget.md): Curling IO provides two widgets you can use to embed your leagues, competitions, and product data on your website.
- [Club Settings](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/settings.md): You can modify all of the core operational settings for your club in this screen.
- [Sponsors](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/sponsors.md): This is a Premium Only Feature
- [Support and Feedback](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/support.md): You can submit support and feedback requests from within Curling IO. Requests submitted any other way may be missed or at a minimum will take longer for a response.
- [Waitlists](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/waitlists.md): Overview
- [Waivers](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/waivers.md): Curling IO allows you to collect legal agreements, liability releases, photo consents, and other acknowledgments from your curlers during registration. The waiver system supports both required waivers (where users must type acceptance text to continue) and optional waivers (where users can choose to accept or reject).
- [Website Hosting](https://curling.io/docs/club-management/website-hosting.md): Overview

### event-management

- [Bracket Templates](https://curling.io/docs/event-management/bracket-templates.md): This is a Premium Only Feature
- [Profiles](https://curling.io/docs/event-management/curlers.md): The profiles screen for an event will list all of the profiles who registered for the event.
- [Draw Schedule](https://curling.io/docs/event-management/draw-schedule.md): Walkthrough Video
- [Draw Schedule Templates](https://curling.io/docs/event-management/draw-schedule-templates.md): This is a Premium Only Feature
- [Event Managers](https://curling.io/docs/event-management/event-managers.md): Walkthrough Video
- [Playoff Brackets](https://curling.io/docs/event-management/playoff-brackets.md): Walkthrough Video
- [Registrations](https://curling.io/docs/event-management/registrations.md): You can manage the registrations for each of your leagues or competitions.
- [Round Robins](https://curling.io/docs/event-management/round-robins.md): To get to the stages screen and manage your round robins, first click on the name of a league of competition.
- [Scores](https://curling.io/docs/event-management/scores.md): Walkthrough Video
- [Spares](https://curling.io/docs/event-management/spares.md): If you enabled Sparing for your league or competitions, then you can review the spares for it on this screen.
- [Teams](https://curling.io/docs/event-management/teams.md): Walkthrough Video

### for-curlers

- [Curler Profiles](https://curling.io/docs/for-curlers/curler-profiles.md): Overview
- [Google Login Without Gmail](https://curling.io/docs/for-curlers/google-login-without-gmail.md): You can use a non-gmail email account to login using the "Login with Gmail" button.
- [How do I Login?](https://curling.io/docs/for-curlers/how-do-i-login.md): It's simple, but first you need an email address.
- [My Events](https://curling.io/docs/for-curlers/my-events.md): Once you've joined a league or competition with one of your profiles, either by purchasing it or via a join link from a teammate, they'll show up in this section.
- [Orders](https://curling.io/docs/for-curlers/orders.md): Once you've placed at least one order (registration and / or purchase) you'll be able to review your orders in this section.
- [Registering for a League](https://curling.io/docs/for-curlers/registering-for-a-league.md): Step by Step
- [Sparing](https://curling.io/docs/for-curlers/sparing.md): If your club has enabled the sparing feature for any of their leagues or competitions you will be able to select which of them you are available to spare for, which position(s) you prefer, and other notes you'd like to include.
- [My Teams](https://curling.io/docs/for-curlers/teams.md): Once your profile(s) has been assigned to a team in a league or competition, that team will show up in this section.
- [Waitlists](https://curling.io/docs/for-curlers/waitlists.md): Once a league, competition, or product runs out of space or inventory, you may be presented with an option to join it's waitlist.
- [Waivers](https://curling.io/docs/for-curlers/waivers.md): Your club may ask you to respond to one or more waivers before you can participate at their venue. You'll usually be asked during event registration.

### getting-started

- [Best Practices](https://curling.io/docs/getting-started/best-practices.md): This document is for curling club managers that are new to Curling IO or club's who's pricing, fees, or discounts have undergone significant changes for the next season.
- [Book an Onboarding Session](https://curling.io/docs/getting-started/book-an-onboarding-session.md): The goal of an onboarding session is to get the leagues, fees, discounts, and products setup to mirror your club's operations, and answer any questions you may have.
- [Curling Club Management](https://curling.io/docs/getting-started/curling-club-managers.md): Curling IO is the #1 curling club management and registration platform.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://curling.io/docs/getting-started/faq.md): How much does it cost?
- [Premium Tier](https://curling.io/docs/getting-started/premium.md): If your club is accepting online payments then you are already considered premium tier.
- [Pricing](https://curling.io/docs/getting-started/pricing.md): Run Your Curling Club for $0
- [Referrals](https://curling.io/docs/getting-started/referrals.md): Clubs can earn $250 for every club that you refer to Curling IO that has never used our platform before.
- [Support and Feedback](https://curling.io/docs/getting-started/support.md): We offer two options available for help and support with Curling IO.

### member-data

- [Setup for Membership Associations](https://curling.io/docs/member-data/setup.md): Overview
